subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: Should OpenClaw adopt permanent cross-client question summaries and the Control UI panel-as-composer takeover as the default interaction model?
rationale: This PR intentionally changes the default interaction and recovery model across multiple supported clients; code review cannot determine whether that product direction is preferred over preserving the existing composer and transient-question behavior.

options.title: Approve the parity direction
options.body: Accept permanent summaries and panel-as-composer, subject to fixing the identified ordering/docs defects and supplying native real-behavior proof.

options.title: Narrow to recovery fixes
options.body: Keep the reconnection and terminal-state correctness work but preserve the current Control UI composer layout and avoid changing the default cross-client history model.

options.title: Split by platform
options.body: Land only the independently validated native or web portions after separate owner approval and proof for each surface.

recommendation.title: Approve the parity direction
recommendation.body: Accept permanent summaries and panel-as-composer, subject to fixing the identified ordering/docs defects and supplying native real-behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the self-assigned proposer of the cross-client interaction direction and authored the current question-parity implementation.
